description: The timeless SCHUBERT STONE COOLER consists of a million years old sandstone, which has been mined for more than 2000 years and was already used by the Romans. The special characteristic of this stone is its porous surface. Previously soaked in cold water, the bottle cooler keeps pre-cooled drinks pleasantly cool for hours due to the evaporation cooling effect. Perfect as a gift, for the home, in the garden or at events.
